context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual rendering fix is VERIFIED. The fix involved: 1) Changing iframe body CSS in SlideCanvas.jsx lines 722-726 from width:960px/height:540px to width:100%/height:100%, 2) Adding sanitizeHtmlForDisplay function at lines 51-68 that removes --tw-* CSS variables and outline-style/outline-width. The sanitization reduces bloated content (75KB to ~6KB) and allows images to render. Test project 'Test RTF Overflow Fix' has an HTML element with a floated coffee plantation image. Key selectors: data-testid='slide-canvas' for canvas, data-testid='element-{id}' for elements.
